description: We are a team of students who are passionate about space, science and technology. We are eager to learn new things, explore creative ideas and challenge ourselves through this competition. We value teamwork, communication and creativity. We welcome members who are enthusiastic, responsible, hardworking and willing to share their ideas. We are looking for teammates with skills in research, problem-solving, designing, coding or presentation.
summary: EarthPulse aims to explore and understand changes in Earth's interconnected environmental systems. Our project focuses on identifying environmental trends, such as rising temperatures, changing climate patterns and decreasing biodiversity. We also investigate the natural and human activities that contribute to these changes and their impacts on our planet. Through scientific observations and data analysis, we hope to raise environmental awareness and encourage sustainable actions to protect Earth for future generations.
details: EarthPulse is an educational project that explores changes in Earth's interconnected environmental systems, including rising temperatures, climate change, pollution and biodiversity loss. It explains the causes and impacts of these changes through scientific information and creative visual presentations. Our project aims to raise environmental awareness, encourage sustainable lifestyles and inspire people to protect our planet. We focus on scientific accuracy, creativity and clear communication to make environmental information easier to understand. We use online research and digital tools to develop and present our project.
